changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla assessment_items: banco de ítems pregenerados (diagnóstico, quiz, final y retención) con su estado de revisión. Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría assessment_items_audit y el trigger assessment_items_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Pre-generated item bank (diagnostic, topic quiz, final and retention items)

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key

column.name: public_id
column.remarks: Public identifier exposed by the API instead of the sequential id

column.name: topic_id
column.remarks: Topic the item evaluates

column.name: learning_outcome_id
column.remarks: Learning outcome the item evaluates

column.name: source
column.remarks: Item bank: diagnostic, topic_quiz, final or retention

column.name: item_type
column.remarks: Item type: multiple_choice or short_answer

column.name: bloom_level
column.remarks: Bloom taxonomy level of the item

column.name: difficulty
column.remarks: Difficulty from 1 (easy) to 3 (hard)

column.name: stem
column.remarks: Question statement

column.name: options
column.remarks: Options of a multiple choice item

column.name: correct_option
column.remarks: Key of the correct option

column.name: model_answer
column.remarks: Model answer of a short answer item

column.name: rubric
column.remarks: Grading rubric of a short answer item

column.name: equivalence_group
column.remarks: Group of equivalent items (final and retention versions)

column.name: review_status
column.remarks: Review status: auto_rejected, pending_review, approved or retired

column.name: auto_review
column.remarks: Result of the automatic review by the LLM

column.name: prompt_version
column.remarks: Version of the prompt that generated the item

column.name: ai_job_id
column.remarks: AI job that generated the item

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation timestamp

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE assessment_items ADD CONSTRAINT assessment_items_source_ck CHECK (source IN ('diagnostic', 'topic_quiz', 'final', 'retention'))
ALTER TABLE assessment_items ADD CONSTRAINT assessment_items_type_ck CHECK (item_type IN ('multiple_choice', 'short_answer'))
ALTER TABLE assessment_items ADD CONSTRAINT assessment_items_bloom_level_ck CHECK (bloom_level IN ('remember', 'understand', 'apply', 'analyze', 'evaluate', 'create'))
ALTER TABLE assessment_items ADD CONSTRAINT assessment_items_difficulty_ck CHECK (difficulty BETWEEN 1 AND 3)
ALTER TABLE assessment_items ADD CONSTRAINT assessment_items_review_status_ck CHECK (review_status IN ('auto_rejected', 'pending_review', 'approved', 'retired'))

ALTER TABLE assessment_items ADD CONSTRAINT assessment_items_shape_ck CHECK ((item_type = 'multiple_choice' AND options IS NOT NULL AND correct_option IS NOT NULL) OR (item_type = 'short_answer' AND model_answer IS NOT NULL))
CREATE TRIGGER assessment_items_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON assessment_items FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in assessment_items

column.name: operation
column.remarks: INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE

column.name: old_data
column.remarks: Row before the change

column.name: new_data
column.remarks: Row after the change

column.name: changed_at
column.remarks: Moment of the change

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE assessment_items_audit ADD CONSTRAINT assessment_items_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER assessment_items_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON assessment_items FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS assessment_items_audit_trg ON assessment_items
